text: Industrial Design (abbreviated as ID) is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates technology, aesthetics, user needs and business value. It takes "solving problems" as its core, and through systematic design of the product's functions, forms, materials, human-computer interaction and other aspects, enhances the practicality, aesthetics and market competitiveness of the product. Its essence is to coordinate the relationship among "people - products - environment - society", and promote industrial innovation and user experience upgrading.
